# pve_ha_rule (Data Source)

Reads a single HA rule from `GET /cluster/ha/rules/{rule}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ha_rule" "keep_db" {
  rule = "keep-db-on-pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule` (String) HA rule identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `affinity` (String) Rule affinity: `positive` or `negative`.
- `comment` (String) HA rule description.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the HA rule is disabled.
- `nodes` (List of String) For `node-affinity` rules: cluster node members as `<node>` or `<node>:<priority>` entries.
- `resources` (List of String) HA resource IDs the rule applies to (e.g. `vm:100`, `ct:101`).
- `strict` (Boolean) For `node-affinity` rules: whether the rule is strict.
- `type` (String) HA rule type: `node-affinity` or `resource-affinity`.
